response.sql: WITH product_volumes AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) as product_total_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), total_volume AS (SELECT SUM(product_total_qty) as total_qty FROM product_volumes), product_shares AS (SELECT pv.product_id, pv.product_total_qty, pv.product_total_qty / tv.total_qty as product_share FROM product_volumes pv CROSS JOIN total_volume tv), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(product_share) as avg_share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(ps.product_total_qty) as combined_order_volume, AVG(ps.product_share) as average_share, AVG(ps.product_share - av.avg_share) as avg_above_average FROM product_shares ps CROSS JOIN average_share av WHERE ps.product_share > av.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity in Order_Items is numeric or can be successfully cast to DECIMAL(19,4); it is the measure of volume for this calculation
